scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.deploy:admin:firebase: pnpm run build:admin:firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting --project heavyar-app --config artifacts/heavyar-admin/firebase.json --non-interactive
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:mobile && pnpm run test:worker && pnpm run test:admin && pnpm run test:shared
